R7AE-grouse-drive-0003.parkWhat: pull off on Cp 662 Amend 13 (gravel road)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
16 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
5 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: Omineca South and Central. Closed between 4:30 a.m. and 8:00 a.m. from August 15 to August 31, between 5:30 a.m. and 9:00 a.m. from September 1 to September 30 and between 6:30 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. from October 1 to November 15. Synopsis map 7-3/24.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 7A table (page 57), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). MU 7-1 is listed in Region 7A on page 2 but no row names it.

plan: Drive: from District of Mackenzie, about 89 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Coquiwaldie Rd, unsigned, Finlay-Causeway FSR, Finlay-Causeway FSR Bridge.
Park: 54.73142, -123.53255, pull off on Cp 662 Amend 13 (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Cp 662 Amend 13 stretch, 4.2 km one way. About 85 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-24, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-04, closures 2026-10-16.
